summary: Backend + frontend regression run completed for translation, composer/call routes, and crash-related surfaces. Backend APIs passed (4/4). Frontend remains route-stable in preview, but the call header contact name is currently rendered as hidden on mobile web call screen, and authenticated real-data validations are still blocked.

ui_bugs.issue: `call-contact-name` element exists with text (`Smilers`) but is not visible on /call/[conversationId]?type=voice at 375x667, so the caller/contact name disappears from UI.

integration_issues.flow: Real contact open crash validation (Asare Ben Chris)
integration_issues.issue: Could not validate end-to-end because authenticated production contact data flow was not reachable in this automation run.

integration_issues.flow: Saved-contact naming + last-seen freshness + incoming auto-translation
integration_issues.issue: Unauthenticated preview falls back to unavailable conversation state, so real contact-name substitution, real-time last-seen parity, and incoming-message translation behavior could not be fully proven.
Runtime validation is blocked in web preview; requires native device call notification tests with a signed-in account.

issues: Primary contact title is not visible in rendered UI, reducing call identity clarity.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated Convex query server-error warnings for `conversations:getConversation` and `messages:list` still occur on invalid/unauth chat route, though fallback UI prevents red-screen crash.

action_items: Fix call-screen name visibility regression so `call-contact-name` renders visibly on compact/mobile viewport.

Run authenticated device-level regression with real account/contact data to verify: Asare Ben Chris no-crash path, saved-contact-name parity in chat/call, fresh last-seen behavior, and auto-translation on incoming messages.
Run Android native incoming-call notification tests across foreground/background/killed states to confirm selected ringtone channel sync while keeping message alert sound separate.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx` and `/app/frontend/app/call/[conversationId].tsx` are very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and making targeted UI fixes harder.
Call screen currently mounts the name node but keeps it hidden in rendered state at tested viewport, indicating a layout/style conflict around hero metadata rendering.
Backend `/api/translate` endpoint is functional (pytest verified) and returns non-empty translated text with target+skip payloads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is green with reusable pytest coverage for root/translate/status. Preview route stability is good (no red-screen crash on root/chat/call), disappearing option selection no longer crashes, but real user/contact/call-state validations remain blocked without authenticated native testing.
rca_of_issue: Reproduced on /call/testconversation1?type=voice (375x667): `call-contact-name` node count=1, text='Smilers', visible_count=0. This indicates a rendering/layout styling conflict (not missing data), causing caller/contact name to be hidden even when value exists.
